dialogue.origin: (お疲れ様です。よろしくお願いします。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.origin: (おつかれさまです。こちらこそよろしくお願いします。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you. I look forward to it as well.)

dialogue.origin: （予定時刻12時30分に開始させてもらいます。よろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (We will begin at the scheduled time of 12:30. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: (はい。よろしくお願いします。)
dialogue.content: (Yes. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。はじめにご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 中学３年生女子です。
dialogue.content: I'm a third-year junior high school girl.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: はい。もうすぐ夏休みが終わります。嫌だな……
dialogue.content: Well, summer vacation is ending soon. I'm really dreading it...

dialogue.origin: 確かに夏休み終わると学校が始まりますもんね。
dialogue.content: I understand. When summer vacation ends, school starts again, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです…
dialogue.content: That's right...

dialogue.origin: 学校が楽しくないんですか？
dialogue.content: Is it that you don't enjoy school?

dialogue.origin: 楽しい事は楽しいんですけど、休み明けからテストもあるし。
dialogue.content: It's fun sometimes, but there are also tests right after the break.

dialogue.origin: テストがあるなら勉強しないといけないからめんどくさいですよね。
dialogue.content: Having tests means you have to study, which can be a hassle, right?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです…
dialogue.content: Exactly...

dialogue.origin: 休み明けのテストがあるから学校にあまり行きたくないとお考えなんですね。
dialogue.content: So, you're not really looking forward to going back to school because of the tests right after the break.

dialogue.origin: はい。テストが続きます…
dialogue.content: Yes. The tests keep coming...

dialogue.origin: どれぐらい続くのですか？
dialogue.content: How long will that go on for?

dialogue.origin: 夏休み明けテストから始まり、来月だけで3回あります。
dialogue.content: It starts with the test after summer vacation, and there are three next month alone.

dialogue.origin: 3回もあると集中して勉強しないといけないので疲れますよね。
dialogue.content: With three tests, you have to study intensively, which must be exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 集中してなかなか出来ないですよね
dialogue.content: It's hard to really concentrate, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 集中して勉強するのは難しいですもんね。
dialogue.content: It certainly is difficult to study with such focus.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 夏休み期間はどのように過ごしていたのですか？
dialogue.content: How did you spend your summer vacation?

dialogue.origin: とりあえず塾の夏期講習とか課題とかして過ごしてました。
dialogue.content: I basically spent it doing things like the cram school's summer session and my assignments.

dialogue.origin: 夏休み期間中も勉強していたのですね。
dialogue.content: So you were studying during your summer vacation as well.

dialogue.origin: とりあえずやらないと……
dialogue.content: Well, I felt like I had to...

dialogue.origin: 勉強していてもテストになると不安になりますよね。
dialogue.content: Even if you study, it's natural to feel anxious when it comes to tests, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。成績とか出るし。
dialogue.content: Yes. And we get our grades back and everything.

dialogue.origin: 成績がでても学力が伸びてないと落ち込みますもんね
dialogue.content: And if your grades come out and it doesn't seem like your academic ability has improved, it can be discouraging.

dialogue.origin: 夏休み明けのテストはとても不安なんです。みんな頑張ってただろうし…
dialogue.content: I'm really anxious about the test after summer vacation. I'm sure everyone else has been studying hard...

dialogue.origin: テストも続くし
dialogue.content: And the tests keep coming.

dialogue.origin: テストも続くし不安ですよね。あなたは夏休み期間中どれぐらい勉強していましたか？
dialogue.content: With tests continuing, it's understandable to feel anxious. About how much did you study over the summer?

dialogue.origin: 塾は毎日３時間授業があったし、他に8時間くらいかな？
dialogue.content: I had three hours of class at cram school every day, and maybe about 8 hours on top of that?

dialogue.origin: 毎日11時間も勉強していたのですね。そんなに毎日頑張って勉強できる人はいないと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: You were studying 11 hours a day? I don't think many people can keep that up every day.

dialogue.origin: そうですかね？みんなしてると思います。
dialogue.content: Really? I feel like everyone does that.

dialogue.origin: 友達にどれぐらい勉強しているか聞いたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you asked your friends how much they're studying?

dialogue.origin: 塾の友達は同じくらい勉強してる様子でした……なんか時間はしてるけど、集中出来てなかった気もするし…
dialogue.content: My friends at cram school seemed to be studying about the same amount... But I feel like even though I put in the hours, I wasn't really able to concentrate...

dialogue.origin: 友人は集中できていないと感じたのですね。
dialogue.content: You felt that your friends weren't able to concentrate?

dialogue.origin: 集中出来てなかったのは私なんです。みんなすごく出来てるような気がするんです。
dialogue.content: I'm the one who couldn't concentrate. It feels like everyone else is doing really well.

dialogue.origin: あなたが集中できていないのですね。模擬テストなどで成績がでると思いますが周りと比べてどうですか？
dialogue.content: I see, so it's you who feels you can't concentrate. When you get your grades back from mock tests and things, how do you feel you compare to those around you?

dialogue.origin: 勉強はしたつもりなので成績が上がっても、周りもみんな夏休みは勉強してただろうし、みんなも成績が上がると思います。
dialogue.content: I feel like I did study, so even if my grades go up, I'm sure everyone else studied over the summer too, so I think their grades will all go up as well.

dialogue.origin: 周りの人も勉強しているので比べにくいですよね。
dialogue.content: It's hard to compare when you know everyone else is studying too, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、不安になりますね。
dialogue.content: Right, it makes me anxious.

dialogue.origin: 最初に塾に入ったときと今を比べて成績はどのぐらい変わりましたか？
dialogue.content: How have your grades changed compared to when you first started cram school?

dialogue.origin: 塾は小学校から入ってます。なので成績は変わったのか分かりません。少しずつ成績は上がってきてました。
dialogue.content: I've been going to cram school since elementary school. So, I'm not sure how much they've changed. They've been improving gradually.

dialogue.origin: 小学生から頑張っていたら比較しにくいですね。毎日積み重ね頑張っていたのですね。努力家ですね。
dialogue.content: It's hard to compare if you've been working at it since elementary school. It shows you've been putting in consistent effort every day. You're a hard worker.

dialogue.origin: そうですかね。なんかやらないと不安で。
dialogue.content: Do you think so? I just feel anxious if I don't study.

dialogue.origin: 勉強しないと学力落ちるから不安になりますよね。
dialogue.content: It's natural to feel anxious about your academic ability dropping if you don't study.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。不安です。
dialogue.content: That's right. I feel anxious.

dialogue.origin: 勉強についての不安を相談できる人はいますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have anyone you can talk to about your study-related anxiety?

dialogue.origin: んー今はいないかなぁ。
dialogue.content: Hmm, not right now, I think.

dialogue.origin: 前は相談できる人がいたのですか？
dialogue.content: Did you have someone you could talk to before?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、中2までは友達と勉強の不安な話とかはしてました。
dialogue.content: Yes, until my second year of middle school, I used to talk with my friends about our anxieties with studying and things.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。友達に相談したときはどのような感情になりましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. How did you feel when you talked to your friends about it?

dialogue.origin: その時は今ほど勉強について不安もなかったんです。
dialogue.content: Back then, I wasn't as anxious about studying as I am now.

dialogue.origin: 嫌だよね〜って感じで話せてました
dialogue.content: We could just talk about it like, 'Ugh, this is a pain, isn't it?'

dialogue.origin: 相談したら不安はなかったのですね。それなら友達に相談したら不安がなくなるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: So you didn't feel anxious when you talked about it. In that case, maybe talking to your friends could help ease your anxiety now.

dialogue.origin: みんな忙しいし、必死なんですよね…
dialogue.content: Everyone is busy and trying their best...

dialogue.origin: それなら他に相談できそうな人はいますか？
dialogue.content: In that case, is there anyone else you might be able to talk to?

dialogue.origin: 成績みて先生ですかね？
dialogue.content: Maybe a teacher who can look at my grades?

dialogue.origin: 塾の先生にも話せるかも。
dialogue.content: I might be able to talk to my cram school teacher, too.

dialogue.origin: 確かに先生なら相談しやすそうでね。今の勉強の不安を話すだけでも少し楽になると思いますよ。
dialogue.content: Yes, teachers do seem easier to talk to. Even just sharing your current worries about studying might make you feel a bit lighter.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 勉強で不安なことがあると思いますが頑張ってください。
dialogue.content: I know you have anxieties about your studies, but please keep doing your best.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 他に質問したいことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: No, I'm okay.

dialogue.origin: それでは、本日のご相談はここで終了とさせていただきます。お時間を作ってお話をお聞かせいただき、どうもありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Alright then, we'll conclude today's session here. Thank you very much for taking the time to speak with me today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.
